Hi Mackenzie,

Those are warning messages (rather than error messages). Are you running ctmm.fit rather than ctmm.select ?

Then if you do run ctmm.select, is the selected model IID?

And if the selected model is IID, are there large errors or tiny sampling intervals in the data that need to be dealt with?

Best,
Chris
